15	use crate::Url;
16	use form_urlencoded::EncodingOverride;
17	use percent_encoding::{percent_encode, utf8_percent_encode, AsciiSet, CONTROLS};
18	
19	/// https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#fragment-percent-encode-set
20	const FRAGMENT: &AsciiSet = &CONTROLS.add(b' ').add(b'"').add(b'<').add(b'>').add(b'`');
21	
22	/// https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#path-percent-encode-set
23	const PATH: &AsciiSet = &FRAGMENT.add(b'#').add(b'?').add(b'{').add(b'}');
24	
25	/// https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#userinfo-percent-encode-set
26	pub(crate) const USERINFO: &AsciiSet = &PATH
27	    .add(b'/')
28	    .add(b':')
29	    .add(b';')
30	    .add(b'=')
31	    .add(b'@')
32	    .add(b'[')
33	    .add(b'\\')
34	    .add(b']')
35	    .add(b'^')
36	    .add(b'|');
37	
38	pub(crate) const PATH_SEGMENT: &AsciiSet = &PATH.add(b'/').add(b'%');
39	
40	// The backslash (\) character is treated as a path separator in special URLs
41	// so it needs to be additionally escaped in that case.
42	pub(crate) const SPECIAL_PATH_SEGMENT: &AsciiSet = &PATH_SEGMENT.add(b'\\');

The `url` crate now percent-encodes `^` in paths, so `http://localhost/a^b` parses to `http://localhost/a%5Eb`. `cargo test -p url` passes. I didn't run tests for the other workspace crates.

- **Fix:** I added `^` to the `PATH` encode set in `url/src/parser.rs`. The userinfo and path-segment sets are built from `PATH`, so they inherit it. Userinfo already encoded `^`, so nothing changes there.
- **Test:** I added `test_path_percent_encodes_caret` to `url/tests/unit.rs`.
- **Expected failures:** Three WPT cases that were listed as known failures now pass: two `foo://host/…` and `wss://host/…` path cases, and one `set pathname` case. They made the suite report "unexpected success", so I removed them from `url/tests/expected_failures.txt`.

I didn't commit anything.
